title: Discount Ceiling on a Self-Pay Visit Package Bought Again in the Same Tier
content:
**Discount controls.** The total discount on a Self-Pay Visit Package bought again in the same tier is capped, before it is applied to the list price: at **35 percent** where every visit of the exhausted package was used at an attended appointment and the tier includes six visits or fewer, at **30 percent** where fewer visits were used at attended appointments than the exhausted package included, and otherwise not at all.

**Reading the exhausted package**

- *Visits used at attended appointments:* the package visits drawn by the attended appointments recorded in the exhausted package's history (an extended or specialty visit may draw more than one).
- *Visits the exhausted package included:* the visits purchased on that package.
- *Tier includes six visits or fewer:* the Starter 4-Visit Package and the Recovery 6-Visit Package.

**Ceiling table**

| Visits used at attended appointments, against the visits included | Tier of six visits or fewer | Ceiling on the total discount |
|---|---|---|
| at least as many | Yes | 35 percent |
| at least as many | No | no ceiling |
| fewer | either | 30 percent |

**Hypothetical examples**

- Recovery 6-Visit Package, all 6 visits used at attended appointments, total discount 40 percent: capped at 35 percent.
- Core 8-Visit Package, 6 of 8 visits used at attended appointments (2 forfeited), total discount 33 percent: capped at 30 percent.
- Core 8-Visit Package, 6 of 8 used, total discount 25 percent: below the ceiling, it stays at 25 percent.
- Comprehensive 24-Visit Package, all 24 used, total discount 40 percent: no ceiling.
